row.title: BOOTPROOF-1: seed kernel closure audit and daily scratch bootstrap
row.body: foundation/bootproof.py audits seed/ as a fresh checkout (imports, wrangler placeholders, migrations, secrets with degrade and acquire routes, triggers); seedlaunch --e2e-scratch deploys a never-used slug through OIDC daily. Migration 0010 duplicate grandfathered, shrink-only. Scratch teardown still missing (site worker has no delete endpoint).
